summary.short_summary: The discussion highlighted the company's significant growth, achieving $2.3 million in revenue over the past year and projecting a $3 million run rate for 2026. With high gross margins of 85-90%, the business operates on a commission model that ensures stable revenue through minimum monthly fees ranging from $2,500 to $10,000. Notably, the company has signed 110 contracts in the last year, demonstrating organic demand with an 80-90% close rate. Their proprietary dataset includes over 300 million users, allowing for targeted advertising across various platforms. The company serves a diverse client base, including major players in gaming and finance, and aims to scale revenue dramatically with strategic partnerships and a data-as-a-service platform.
